description: This file defines the tracing API for debugging and performance measurement in a Git-related project. It includes structure definitions, macro utilities, and function prototypes for trace control, output, and timing.

methods.name: trace_repo_setup
methods.description: Sets up tracing for a given repository.

methods.name: trace_want
methods.description: Checks if a trace key is enabled to avoid unnecessary formatting.

methods.name: trace_override_envvar
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing for a specific key based on environment variable.

methods.name: trace_disable
methods.description: Disables tracing for a specific key.

methods.name: getnanotime
methods.description: Returns high-precision current time in nanoseconds since epoch.

methods.name: trace_command_performance
methods.description: Logs performance data for a command.

methods.name: trace_performance_enter
methods.description: Marks the start of a performance measurement.

methods.name: trace_printf_key_fl
methods.description: Backend function for formatted trace output with file and line info.

methods.name: trace_argv_printf_fl
methods.description: Backend function for formatted trace output with argument list.

methods.name: trace_strbuf_fl
methods.description: Backend function for outputting a strbuf.

methods.name: trace_performance_fl
methods.description: Backend function for performance timing output.

methods.name: trace_performance_leave_fl
methods.description: Backend function for marking end of a performance measurement.

methods.name: trace_pass_fl
methods.description: Checks if trace output should be performed based on key state.
